data.name: Closed Space
data.detailed_description:
Embark on an action-packed cosmic journey through a vast sector of unexplored space! Pilot your starship across an open universe, locate hidden worlds, and fight your way to ultimate galactic dominance.

EXPLORE, SHOOT, AND UPGRADE

Traverse an expansive open-space environment to locate uncharted planets. Each world presents intense, level-based space-shooter combat where your reflexes and tactical choices determine survival. Clear planetary stages to earn valuable resources and continuously upgrade your ship's core stats.

KEY FEATURES

  • Open Space Exploration: Fly freely through space, scan distant sectors, and discover unique planets.

  • Action-Packed Planetary Combat: Engage in challenging space-shooter levels on discovered planets to unlock high-tier rewards.

  • Deep Ship Progression: Use earned resources to upgrade your ship's stats, firepower, and durability.

  • Resource Gathering & Module Crafting: Harvest raw materials drifting in open space to construct specialized ship modules.

  • Unique Active Abilities: Equip custom modules to grant your starship powerful active skills and tailor your fleet to your personal playstyle.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650
  • DirectX: Version 11
